metaobjects-core-types: Core metaobjects metamodel types and subtypes.
metaobjects-db: DB-domain attributes — @column / @db.indexed / @dbColumnType on every field, @storage on field.object, @autoSet on temporal fields, @table/@kind/@role/@schema on source.rdb.
metaobjects-documentation: Universal documentation common attrs (description / title / notes / deprecated / replacedBy / seeAlso / aliases) accepted on every metatype.
metaobjects-prompt: Prompt / AI + serialization domain — @xmlText / @example / @instruction field markers on every field subtype, the @enumAlias/@enumDoc/@coerceDefault/@normalize tolerant-extract overlays on field.enum, and the object-level @normalize default on object.value.
metaobjects-reporting: Reporting (FR-044): object.report, dimension / measure / segment on an entity, and @segment on origin.aggregate and origin.first.
metaobjects-requirements: Requirements: requirement.functional and requirement.architectural, declared at the document root and checked by meta verify.
metaobjects-rules: Business rules (ADR-0066, experimental): the declared API surface (api / operation / binding) and lifecycle moves (transition on a field.enum).
metaobjects-ui: UI/query-surface domain — @filterable / @sortable / @sortableDefaultOrder field markers driving generated CRUD filter + sort allowlists (Project D).
metaobjects-ui-web: Web presentation view attrs — @rows (view.textarea) and the view.image control attrs. Every port applies this provider and loads them strictly; only TypeScript acts on them so far.
metaobjects-view-expressions: View expressions (rc.21): origin.function plus the projection @union / @unionAll / @grain / @grainOrdinal attributes.
